title: notebook store/1
description: The evidence notebook as the browser keeps it (one localStorage key): its schema number and the entries in order. js/notebook/store.js load() is the authority and checks the schema number only (a record from a newer version is kept and not overwritten, in words: `from-a-newer-version`), a value that is not JSON is `unreadable`, and an entry is checked when it is revived (notebook entry snapshot/1). The entries are open objects here for that reason. FORMATS.md lists it.
